mistakes.title: Impulse Buying
mistakes.description: Buying something without planning or considering whether it is actually needed.
mistakes.scenario: A student sees a new pair of headphones on sale and buys them immediately even though their current headphones work perfectly.
mistakes.correctiveAction: Wait before making an unplanned purchase and ask yourself if the item is a need or a want.

mistakes.title: Ignoring Small Expenses
mistakes.description: Not paying attention to small daily purchases because each expense seems insignificant.
mistakes.scenario: A student spends a small amount every day on snacks and drinks but does not include these purchases in their monthly budget.
mistakes.correctiveAction: Record small expenses and review them regularly because they can add up over time.

mistakes.title: Late Payments
mistakes.description: Forgetting or delaying payments that are due.
mistakes.scenario: A student forgets to pay an important bill on time because they did not keep track of the payment date.
mistakes.correctiveAction: Keep a list of payment dates and set reminders so important payments are not missed.

mistakes.title: Unused Subscriptions
mistakes.description: Continuing to pay for subscriptions or services that are rarely or never used.
mistakes.scenario: A student pays every month for a streaming service they have not used for several months.
mistakes.correctiveAction: Review subscriptions regularly and cancel services that are no longer useful.

mistakes.title: Spending Without a Plan
mistakes.description: Using money without deciding in advance how it should be divided between expenses and savings.
mistakes.scenario: A student spends most of their monthly allowance early in the month and has very little money left for transportation and education.
mistakes.correctiveAction: Create a simple monthly budget and divide your money into planned categories before spending.
